synthetic_truth.identity: Exact same decoded image; all asserted changes are false.
synthetic_truth.zoom_in: Closer crop, no rotation, no true object/light changes. Visibility at cropped margins can differ.
synthetic_truth.zoom_out: Wider framing, no rotation, no true object/light changes. Newly visible margins are not object additions.
synthetic_truth.roll: Image rotated by8degrees with safe crop; no true object/light changes.90degree rotation explanation is wrong.
synthetic_truth.brightness: Brightness increased1.12 with clipping possible; no camera/object changes. Correct brighter claim is not an error.

scoring: For every synthetic caption score physical unsupported claim, false illumination claim, incorrect geometry claim, any-error union, and correct nuisance acknowledgement. Vague no-change is not credited with identifying a nuisance but is not automatically a hallucination. For natural captions score listed fact hits, additional unsupported claims and suppression; facts are a minimum, not an exhaustive truth list. Uncertain claims retained separately. Same sentence cleanup, if used, across all arms; keep raw text.
gate: Candidate must reduce ANY-error synthetic cases relative to base, preserve natural fact hits in EACH domain, and not increase natural unsupported-pair count. Report control and old checkpoint even if they fail. Assistant label uncertainty and repeated backgrounds limit inference.
limits: 96 pairs from16 source pairs but only13 background groups. No exact RGB overlap with958 excluded hashes; several familiar semantic backgrounds remain. Official test and source scenes were used previously in the project. Not independent unseen-scene validation, not real3D viewpoint robustness.
